title: Talvia Test Import v2
description: Versioned scoring import contract. test keeps the talvia.test.v1 content shape; scoring adds explicit v2 dimensions, item models, thresholds, composites, norms and overall mapping.

learning_scoring.description: Required when assessment_domain is learning. Weights are validated to sum to 1.

thresholds.description: Optional complete, ordered interpretation ranges for an overall score rounded to two decimals. When omitted, legacy defaults are used.
